you_should_know.title: Federal agents used facial recognition tech to compile protestor photos during Operation Metro Surge
you_should_know.summary: New court filings are shedding light on how federal agents used facial recognition technology to create visual files of protestors during Operation Metro Surge, the federal enforcement push in the Minneapolis-St. Paul area.

you_should_know.title: Former Assistant Anoka County Attorney charged for alleged role in prostitution ring
you_should_know.description: Andrea Leigh Sampson, 35, is charged with 13 counts of promoting prostitution and 13 counts of receiving profits from prostitution.

you_should_know.title: Hundreds scooter through Minneapolis in protest of Flock cameras
you_should_know.summary: Hundreds protested Flock Safety license-plate-reading cameras in Minneapolis Friday night.

you_should_know.title: Family mourns Hopkins daycare victims after deadly violence
you_should_know.summary: The relatives of the Brown family are sharing their grief after the devastating murders at a daycare in Hopkins, a suburb just west of Minneapolis, and at a home in Burnsville, a suburb about 15 miles south of Minneapolis, that have left the communities rattled.
you_should_know.description: The relatives of the Brown family are sharing their grief after the devastating murders at a Hopkins daycare and a Burnsville home last week that have left the communities rattled.
